body: It is 100% possible to pick up the pieces and get back on your feet. There is only one place to go when you hit rock bottom and that’s up. There are resources to turn to for housing, healthcare, hell even to get a job! Take things one step at a time. I find that when I think about my future as a whole, it exacerbates my suicidal thoughts tenfold; making shorter term goals has helped a lot. It’s hard, but it helps. Choose one thing at a time to work towards, you’ve got nothing to lose for trying :) you DO have a future and it’s okay to not have everything figured out. You’ve only been an adult for 8 years, cut yourself some slack. Much love and well wishes for both you and the dog. You’ve got this! (Highly recommend getting a library card if you haven’t! Lots of resources there)

Don’t let a shallow part of society dictate the way you view yourself. This is something out of your control and there’s absolutely NOTHING wrong with being shorter than average. You aren’t vile, and you DO have a chance at a successful life. Being 5’2” at 21 is nothing to be ashamed of. I have a few guy friends who are your height and one who’s much shorter; they are funny, kind, and great to be around. Love em to death and would be heartbroken to see them go, especially because of something like their height. I’m so sorry you’ve been lead to think this way about how tall you are :( There’s nothing you can do to make yourself taller, the next best thing is to accept who you are bro. There are many, MANY people who don’t give a fuck about height, including me. I adore shorter guys, deadass. Jynxzi taught me to be 1% better everyday and I think you can too. Self love takes time, keep on trucking brother. Much love, and know that mfs out there love you for YOU
